DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りの片づけで、お手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help tidying up before leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。座るために新聞紙を敷きました。湿って破れたので、小さい切れ端も集めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 敷いた新聞紙が湿って破れ切片を回収したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I spread newspaper out to sit on. It got damp and tore, so I'd like to collect the little scraps too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the newspaper you spread out became damp and tore, and you want to collect the scraps. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周りの方にぶつからないよう、荷物を先にまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please pack your belongings first so you don't bump into people around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鞄を閉めました。上着もしまったので、この新聞紙だけ片づければ帰れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鞄と上着を先に収納し紙の片付のみ残ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've closed my bag and put my jacket away. Once I've cleared up this newspaper, I'm ready to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you packed your bag and jacket first and only the paper remains to be cleared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切れ端は袋へ入れると、風で飛びにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Putting the scraps in a bag will make them less likely to blow away.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋が一枚あります。大きい紙を先に畳んで、その下に残った細かい紙も入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大紙を畳み下の細片も袋へ集めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a bag. I'll fold the large sheet first, then put the little pieces left underneath into the bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will fold the large sheet and collect the small scraps underneath into a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お使いの場所だけでなく、すぐ横にも落ちていないかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check not just the space you used, but right beside it for fallen scraps too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 横の紙も私の新聞の続きです。広告の同じ文字があるので、これも拾います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 横の広告文字一致する切片も自分紙として拾う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The paper beside me is from my newspaper too. It has the same lettering from the advertisement, so I'll pick that up as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Recognize the matching advertisement lettering on nearby scraps and pick them up as your own paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 片づいたら、退場の案内に沿ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've finished, please follow the exit instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 集められました。袋の口を結びました。子どもにも、そのまま置いて帰らず家へ持って帰ると話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋を閉じ子にも持帰りを伝えて退出すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've collected it all and tied the bag shut. I'll tell my child too that we're taking it home rather than leaving it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have closed the bag and will tell your child to take it home as you leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力いただきありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Have a safe journey home. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お渡しする紙について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the papers we're giving you?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に費用を申請したいので、領収書を残したいです。薬の説明書と、一緒に留めてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 費用申請用領収書と薬説明書の別渡しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to keep the receipt to claim the expenses from my company. Is it attached together with the medicine instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about receiving the expense-claim receipt separately from the medicine instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらが領収書、こちらが薬の説明です。別々にお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the receipt, and these are the medicine instructions. We can give them to you separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会社へ出す方と、自宅で読む方を分けて持ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社提出と自宅閲読の紙を分けたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'd like to keep the paper for my company separate from the one I'll read at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want the company submission and the paper to read at home kept separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 薬の説明は、お薬と一緒にお手元へ残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep the medicine instructions with your medicine.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。会社の封筒には領収書だけ入れます。薬の使い方の紙まで入れてしまわないよう、今ここで分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬説明は手元保持し会社封筒に領収書のみ入れる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll put only the receipt in the company envelope. I'll separate them here now so I don't accidentally include the medicine instructions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the medicine instructions and put only the receipt in the company envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 領収書に記載されたお名前も、お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the name printed on the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の名前になっています。薬代と分かる部分も残すので、切り取らず、このまま会社へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書本人名と薬代記載を切らず保持すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's my name. I'll keep the section showing that it's a medicine expense too, without cutting it off, and check with my company as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your name on the receipt and say you will preserve the medicine-expense entry without cutting it off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社で必要な書類の条件は、勤務先へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask your employer about their requirements for the documents they need.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社が受け付けるかは担当へ聞きます。薬と説明書は自宅へ、領収書は別の封筒へしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社条件は勤務先確認し薬書面と領収書を別収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll ask the person in charge whether the company accepts it. I'll take the medicine and instructions home and put the receipt in a separate envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check company requirements with your employer and store the medicine papers and receipt separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二種類の紙をお渡しします。お忘れ物のないように。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the two kinds of papers, then. Please don't leave anything behind. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り状の差出人欄についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the sender section of the shipping label?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旅行中ですが、ここから荷物を送ります。今泊まっているホテルと、自宅のどちらを書くか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行発送時の差出人住所をホテルか自宅か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm traveling and sending a parcel from here. I'm unsure whether to write my hotel address or my home address.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to use your hotel or home address as the sender when shipping during travel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 万一戻す必要がある場合も含め、連絡できる住所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check an address where you can be contacted, including in case the parcel needs to be returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ホテルは明日の朝に出ます。そのあと戻る予定はないので、ホテルで受け取るつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌朝退泊しホテルで返送品を受取る予定なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm leaving the hotel tomorrow morning and don't plan to return afterward, so I don't intend to receive anything there.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the hotel tomorrow morning and do not plan to receive a returned parcel there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取れる住所や連絡先を、取扱いの案内に沿ってご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check an address and contact details where you can receive it, following the shipping instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自宅には家族がいます。帰る日も伝えてあるので、自宅を差出人住所にしてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族在宅の自宅を差出人住所に使えるか確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family is at home. I've told them when I'll return, so I'd like to check whether I can use home as the sender's address.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use your home address, where family members are present, as the sender address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族が返送品を受け取れるご自宅の住所をお書きください。お名前と連絡先も、ご自身のものをご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write your home address, where your family can receive a returned parcel. Also provide your own name and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前と携帯番号はこちらです。ホテルの電話番号を自分の連絡先として書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名自己携帯を示しホテル電話と混同しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here are my name and mobile number. I'll make sure not to write the hotel's phone number as my own contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your name and mobile number and say you will not confuse them with the hotel's phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取先の住所も、お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the recipient's address.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取先は友人の家です。自宅が差出人、友人宅が受取先と分けて書き、案内を見て仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅差出人友人宅受取人を分け案内で記入すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The destination is my friend's home. I'll write my home as the sender and my friend's home as the destination, and finish following the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish your home as the sender and your friend's home as the destination and fill in the label using the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、送り状の記入をご案内します。よいご旅行になりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-ATAMI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll guide you through filling out the shipping label. Have a pleasant trip. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 片付けが終わったら休憩に入れます。借りた道具はありますか。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can take your break once you've finished tidying up. Have you borrowed any tools?

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測定用の定規を借りました。道具棚へ返したいですが、置く場所が分かりません。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定定規を借り定位置が不明なので尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed a measuring ruler. I'd like to return it to the tool shelf, but I don't know where it belongs.
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you borrowed a measuring ruler and ask about its designated place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 青い印のある定規ですか。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it the ruler with the blue mark?

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、これです。自分のかばんに入れたまま帰らないよう、休憩前に返します。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青印の定規を示し休憩前に返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, this one. I'll return it before my break so I don't leave it in my own bag and take it home.
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the blue-marked ruler and say you will return it before your break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 棚の二段目に、同じ青い印があります。そこへお願いします。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a matching blue mark on the second shelf. Please put it there.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見つかりました。横の長い定規と重ねず、この区画へ一本だけ置きます。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 棚二段目の区画へ他道具と重ねず置くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've found it. I'll put just this ruler in this section without stacking it on the long ruler beside it.
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will put it in the second-shelf section without stacking it with other tools. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使った後の状態はどうでしたか。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: What condition is it in after use?

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙の粉が少し付いています。指定の布で拭いてから戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付着した紙粉を指定布で拭く許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has a little paper dust on it. May I wipe it with the specified cloth before returning it?
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask permission to wipe off the paper dust with the designated cloth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この道具用の布を使ってください。返したら貸出表にも記入します。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please use this cloth for tools. Once you've returned it, we'll record it on the loan sheet too.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 拭いて棚へ戻しました。貸出表の返却欄に時刻を書きます。ほかに借りた物はありません。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 定規返却と時刻記入と他借用品なしを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've wiped it and put it back on the shelf. I'll write the time in the return field of the loan sheet. I haven't borrowed anything else.
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the ruler's return, the time entry, and that you have no other borrowed items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 返却を確認しました。それでは、ゆっくり休憩してください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-SZO-FUJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've confirmed the return. Please enjoy your break. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗る位置について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about where to board?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達が反対の階段から来ます。同じ車両に乗りたいので、待つ位置を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別階段から来る友人と同じ車両に乗りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend is coming up the opposite stairs. We want to get in the same carriage, so I'd like to decide where to wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to board the same carriage as a friend arriving from different stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご利用の列車は、案内表示のこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is your train on the information display, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。その列車です。友達には二両目と送りましたが、ホームのどちらから数えるのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象列車と二両目の数え方への疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, that train. I sent my friend ‘second carriage,’ but I don't know which end of the platform to count from.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the train and ask how to count the second carriage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列車の二両目は、こちらの停車位置表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this train, the second carriage stops at this marker.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この表示の前で待つと、友達に送り直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 示された停車位置前で待つ旨を友人へ送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll send my friend a new message saying I'll wait in front of this marker.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend you will wait in front of the indicated stopping marker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご友人が来るまで、ほかのお客様の列も空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: While waiting for your friend, please keep the other passengers' queue clear too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 列の横で待ちます。友達が着いたら、二人で最後尾に並びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 列脇で合流後に二人で最後尾へ並ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait beside the queue. When my friend arrives, we'll both join at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait beside the queue and both join its end after meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 間もなく列車が来ます。ご友人とは連絡が取れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The train will be here soon. Are you in contact with your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、今階段を上がったそうです。表示が見つかったと返事が来たので、ここで合流して乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人が表示を見つけた連絡を受け合流すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, they say they've just come up the stairs. They've replied that they found the marker, so we'll meet here and board.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say your friend has messaged that they found the marker and you will meet there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元に気をつけてお乗りください。お二人とも、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please watch your step when boarding. Have a good trip, both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 豆腐をお探しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レシピには三百グラムとありますが、同じ大きさのパックが見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レシピの三百グラムに合う豆腐が見つからないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipe says three hundred grams, but I can't find a pack of that size.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you cannot find tofu matching the recipe's three hundred grams. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは一つ百五十グラムです。二つで三百グラムになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Each of these is a hundred and fifty grams. Two make three hundred grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つ買えばよいのですね。これは三個つながっていますが、一個ずつ買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百五十グラム二個で必要量と理解し単品販売を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should buy two. These three are connected; can I buy them individually?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that two hundred-and-fifty-gram packs are not needed, but two packs of a hundred and fifty grams meet the requirement, and ask about individual sales. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この商品は三個一組です。こちらに同じ一個の大きさで、二個一組の商品があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understand that two packs of a hundred and fifty grams meet the requirement and ask about individual sales. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの二個組にします。料理には全部使う予定なので、三個組よりちょうどよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二個組を選び料理に全量使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll take this two-pack. I plan to use it all in the dish, so it suits me better than the three-pack.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the two-pack and say you will use all of it in the dish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 絹と木綿の二種類があります。どちらをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are silken and firm types. Which would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシピには木綿と書いてあります。二個組の木綿はこちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシピ指定の木綿の二個組を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The recipe says firm tofu. Is this the two-pack of firm tofu?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check for the two-pack of firm tofu specified by your recipe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。側面にも種類と量が書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this one. The type and amount are also written on the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木綿、百五十グラムが二つと読めました。この一組を買います。分量を教えていただいて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示で種類と容量を確認して一組購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can read ‘firm tofu, two packs of a hundred and fifty grams.’ I'll buy this set. Thank you for explaining the quantities.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the type and quantity on the label and say you will buy one set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お料理をお楽しみください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Enjoy your cooking, and thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麺について、追加のご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like something more concerning the noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう少し麺を食べたいです。このラーメンに麺だけ追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食事中のラーメンへ麺だけ追加できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a few more noodles. Can I add just noodles to this ramen?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add only noodles to the ramen you are eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、追加麺をご用意できます。普通の量と半分の量がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, we can provide extra noodles. We have regular and half portions.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 半分の量をお願いします。スープはまだこの器に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 半量を選びスープが残ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A half portion, please. I still have soup left in this bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a half portion and say you still have soup. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追加麺は別の小さい器でお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll serve the extra noodles in a separate small bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、自分で食べる分をスープへ移せますね。味は今のままでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別器の麺を少量ずつ移し味は変えないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I can transfer the amount I want to eat into the soup myself. Please leave the flavor as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move noodles from the separate bowl into the soup a little at a time and keep the flavor unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 麺の硬さは、最初と同じでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like the same noodle firmness as the first serving?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初より少し柔らかくできますか。普通の硬さで頼みましたが、次は柔らかめがよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最初の普通より柔らかい追加麺を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could they be a little softer than the first ones? I ordered regular firmness, but I'd like them softer this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request extra noodles softer than the original regular firmness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 半分の量を柔らかめですね。こちらの伝票へ追加します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: A half portion, cooked softer, then. I'll add that to your bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。新しいラーメン一杯ではなく、追加の麺を半分です。出てくるまで、今の器を残しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 半量追加の注文と既存器を残すことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. It's a half portion of extra noodles, not a new bowl of ramen. I'll keep my current bowl until they arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the half-portion addition and that you will keep your current bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。もう少々お待ちください。それでは、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please wait just a little longer. Take your time and enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お着替えの準備はできましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この上着が小さそうです。着る前に、大きいサイズへ替えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未着用の健診上着が小さく交換を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This top looks small. Could you exchange it for a larger size before I put it on?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to exchange an unworn medical-checkup top because it looks too small. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 腕を通したり、着たりされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you put your arms through it or worn it?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。広げて肩幅を見ただけです。いつもは一つ上のサイズを着ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肩幅を見ただけで通常は一つ上のサイズと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I only unfolded it and checked the shoulder width. I usually wear one size larger.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only checked the shoulder width and normally wear one size larger. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、大きいサイズをお持ちします。ズボンの方はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll bring a larger size. How are the trousers?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ズボンはこのサイズでよさそうです。上着だけ交換をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ズボンは元サイズで上着だけ交換したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This size of trousers looks fine. Please exchange just the top.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the trousers can stay the same size and you want only the top exchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが大きい上着です。元の上着はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the larger top. I'll take the original one back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。大きい方には名前を書く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交換上着への記名の要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Do I need to write my name on the larger one?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to write your name on the replacement top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前は書かず、着替えた後にお返しください。お荷物は案内したロッカーへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't write your name on it, and return it after you've changed out of it. Put your belongings in the locker we showed you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。大きい上着に着替えて、私物はロッカーへ入れます。元の上着は今お返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きい上着へ着替え私物収納と旧上着返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll change into the larger top and put my belongings in the locker. I'll return the original top now.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wear the larger top, store your belongings, and return the original top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお受けしました。それでは、お着替え後にお越しください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received it, thank you. Please come back after changing. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの景色をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which view are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 海を見たいです。こちらを見ていましたが、建物しか見えないので、方向が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海が見えず眺める方向が違うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the sea. I've been looking this way, but I can only see buildings. Am I looking in the wrong direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you are looking in the wrong direction because you cannot see the sea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは街側です。海の方向は、案内板の南の表示に沿ってご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the city side. For the sea, please look toward the south shown on the information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 南はこちらですね。今日は少し白くかすんでいますが、あの明るい帯が海ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 南方向を確認して明るい帯が海か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: South is this way, right? It's a little hazy today; is that bright strip the sea?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the southern direction and ask whether the bright strip is the sea. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、ここから見える海の部分です。遠くの船などは、今日は見えにくいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that's the part of the sea visible from here. Distant ships and things are difficult to see today.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 海が見つかったので十分です。写真には街と海を一緒に入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見える海を街と一緒に撮りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Finding the sea is enough for me. I'd like a photo with both the city and the sea in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to photograph the visible sea together with the city. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この位置なら、手前の街と奥の海を見渡せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: From this position you can look over the city in front and the sea beyond.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから撮ります。友達にも見せたいので、海の方向を案内板で覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内位置で撮影し方角表示を覚えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take it from here. I'd like to show my friend too, so I'll remember the direction of the sea using the information board.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph from the indicated spot and remember the direction marker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次に来る時も、同じ景色が見えるとは限りませんが、方向を探す目印になりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The view may not be the same next time you come, but it will help you find the direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は街の奥に海が見える、と写真に書きます。船の名前は分からないので、景色として残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本日の見える景色だけを写真に添えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll caption it ‘Today, the sea is visible beyond the city.’ I don't know the ships' names, so I'll keep it as a scenic photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add only a description of the scenery visible today to the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ゆっくり景色をお楽しみください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time enjoying the view. Have a safe trip home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒を二枚お持ちですが、どちらをお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two envelopes. Which one will you send?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申し込み先へ、この大きい方を送ります。小さい方は返事をもらうために、中へ入れるよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大封筒発送と小封筒同封の返信用途を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll send this large one to the place I'm applying to. I was told to put the small one inside so I can receive a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the large envelope is for mailing and the small enclosed envelope is for a reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さい封筒には、返事を受け取る方の住所を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Write the address of the person receiving the reply on the small envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。二枚とも申し込み先の住所を書こうとしていました。小さい方は私の住所ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返信用小封筒には自分の住所を書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oh, I see. I was about to write the application destination's address on both. The small one needs my address, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the small reply envelope should have your own address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご自身が受け取る住所とお名前をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please enter the address where you will receive it and your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。小さい封筒の口も閉じた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の住所記入後に返信封筒の封をするか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written them. Should I seal the small envelope too?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After entering your address, ask whether to seal the reply envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返信を入れる封筒ですから、口は開けたままで、大きい封筒へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's for them to put the reply into, so leave it open and put it in the large envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。小さい方には何も入れず、申し込みの紙と一緒に大きい方へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信封筒を空で開けたまま申込書と同封すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll leave the small one empty and put it in the large one with the application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will enclose the empty, unsealed reply envelope with the application form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返信用の切手について、申し込み先から指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Did the application destination specify stamps for the reply envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内に指定があるので、それを見て用意します。今日は封筒の書き方が分かったので、一度持ち帰って仕上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定切手を案内で用意して持帰り準備すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The instructions specify them, so I'll prepare them using that information. Now that I understand how to address the envelopes, I'll take them home and finish preparing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the specified stamps using the instructions and take the envelopes home to finish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備できましたらお持ちください。それでは、またのご来局をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring them when you're ready. We look forward to seeing you at the post office again.
